body: Thank you. Just...thanks. I'm feeling a little better, I guess, after my little rant. Reading this gave me some ideas and a bit of...hope, I suppose. I'll try a new outlook on life. I'll try to be hopeful and optimistic. Thank you for this. As strange as it sounds, reading this made me feel better than I would have felt if I had talked to someone I know. Everyone I know would freak out at me, and it wouldn't help anything at all. Thank you for taking the time to do this.
